communityGuides.author: 游戏小助手
supportsParaphrase: Optional skill can follow an off-turn BorrowedSword or another general causing a true Slash Use. Physical, converted and virtual Slash are covered.
Adding targets commits to the exchange/placement remainder; it is not a free target bonus.
Only issuer knows attachment colors. Damage resolves before whole Slash completion; a dying target that is not saved dies before the recovery reward.
Responding target chooses the HE card itself; with no HE it need not give.
communityGuides.limits: Guide normal one-target examples do not impose a global total-target maximum3 and do not adjudicate multi-Dodge, faction providers, redirected targets, extra-effect rounds, deck shortage or empty Hand.

ruleInterpretation.basis: current client XRi TargetCountMin1/Max2 plus related same-product guide
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Add one or two actually new legal other targets to this true native Slash Use. Existing multi-target Uses are not capped at three total. Normal native target range/prohibitions remain; no extra Slash payment or quota debit.

ruleInterpretation.basis: official current skill text and client exchange/placement UI
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Publicly reveal real deck entities equal to the full resulting target count; exchange one current own Hand entity with exactly one revealed entity privately, then privately map the remaining pool to original holders. Only the issuer sees the mapping. Use true Hand loss/gain and exact named private-pile movements.

ruleInterpretation.basis: explicit implementation inference; no dedicated current OL FAQ found
ruleInterpretation.implementation: If no Hand exists at the exchange step, that step does nothing and the actual revealed pool is still placed. Native reshuffle is used; if the deck and discard pile cannot supply all cards, place only real obtained cards in target order and fabricate no marker.

ruleInterpretation.basis: official until-this-Slash-finishes wording; same-product guide damage-before-whole-Slash observation
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Wait for all native target/effect rounds and damage/Dying/death children. A holder that actually responded at least once uses the give branch once, even if damage still occurs due to partial required responses or StoneAxe. Native zero responses and faction response principals retain real actor/provider direction. Pure played Slash for Duel/AOE is not a new Chenglie Slash Use.

ruleInterpretation.basis: explicit composition inference; no dedicated current OL FAQ found
ruleInterpretation.implementation: The original attachment holder and entity are frozen. A later Liuli redirect neither moves the hidden card nor invents a card for its new recipient. Whole-Use response history is a boolean per holder; extra effect rounds do not duplicate the final outcome.

ruleInterpretation.basis: official text, current FLAG3 HE Give selector and same-product guide
ruleInterpretation.implementation: A living responding holder chooses its own legal HE card and gives it to the living original issuer; with no eligible HE no card is fabricated. A living red nonrespondent receives native Recover1 only after damage and rescue settle. All child payments and recoveries finish before advancing another holder.

ruleInterpretation.basis: paid-effect engine contract plus explicit implementation inference; primary text does not state terminal card destination
ruleInterpretation.implementation: Paid setup/outcomes continue after losing the original skill instance. Dead issuers receive no new gift or recovery decisions; stop secret choices and clean exact already-issued entities. A holder dying during setup is not replaced, and its allocated original card is discarded. At whole-Use completion, after eligible outcomes, every attachment still in its exact original private zone is moved to DiscardPile once. Never recover an entity from another zone or leave a dead/source-lost temporary pile.

nativeBoundary: Active resolution is owned by ProgramSkillFrame.Chenglie; the lasting private-card lease is on the original CardUseFrame.ChenglieLease. The exact original completed-use mother issues the resolver before that CardUseFrame is popped. Facts are scalar and frame lists are deeply frozen.
